title: Compendium Library
description: One searchable library for every spell, item, feat, class option and creature in your compendiums: system packs, module packs (including older-edition conversions) and world items, plus a 5e.tools copy in your Data folder if you have one (imported through Plutonium on drop). Filter by source, edition, level, school, class list, rarity, type, CR, size and more; favourites, recents, collections and tags. Drag anything onto a character sheet, the canvas, the sidebar or a compendium.

recommends.reason: Imports 5e.tools entries when you drop them.
